info.name: DriveAI — API Tests
info.description:
Colección Postman/Newman de DriveAI. Cada endpoint tiene al menos un caso de éxito y uno de error (criterio Eje B). Ejecutar con el stack levantado (incluido el mock SOAP):
newman run postman/DriveAI.postman_collection.json --env-var baseUrl=http://localhost:8080 --env-var adminEmail=$ADMIN_EMAIL --env-var adminPassword=$ADMIN_PASSWORD

exec: pm.test('201 y token', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('customerToken', b.token); });
pm.test('200 con ítem', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.be.above(0); pm.collectionVariables.set('cartItemId', b.items[0].id); });
pm.test('200 orden CONFIRMED', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('CONFIRMED'); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', b.id); });

pm.test('200 con paths críticos', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const p = pm.response.json().paths; pm.expect(p).to.have.property('/api/cars'); pm.expect(p).to.have.property('/api/orders/checkout'); pm.expect(p).to.have.property('/api/soap/quote/{carId}'); });
pm.test('409 Problem Details (email ya registrado)', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/problem+json'); });
pm.test('200 y token ADMIN', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.user.role).to.eql('ADMIN'); pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', b.token); });

pm.test('201 con id y ETag', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('ETag')).to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set('newCarId', b.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('newCarEtag', pm.response.headers.get('ETag')); });
pm.test('400 Problem Details (precio 0 y marca vacía)', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/problem+json'); });

item.name: 23 · ADMIN actualiza auto con If-Match vigente

exec: pm.test('200 y guarda ítem', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('newCarId')); const it = pm.response.json().items.find(i => i.car.id === id); pm.expect(it).to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set('newCartItemId', it.id); });

pm.test('200 cantidad 2', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('newCartItemId')); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.find(i => i.id === id).quantity).to.eql(2); });
pm.test('404 Problem Details (ítem no propio)', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/problem+json'); });

pm.test('200 sin el ítem', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('newCartItemId')); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.find(i => i.id === id)).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test('200 CONFIRMED', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('CONFIRMED'); pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId2', b.id); });

pm.test('200 incluye mis órdenes', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const ids = pm.response.json().map(o => o.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId2'))); });

item.name: 39 · Cliente B lee orden de A (BOLA)

exec: pm.test('404 sin filtrar el dato', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('"items"'); });
pm.test('403 Problem Details (solo ADMIN confirma)', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(403); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/problem+json'); });

item.name: 44 · ADMIN borra auto referenciado en una orden (negativo)

exec: pm.test('409 Problem Details (FK con order_items — DEF-09)', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/problem+json'); });

item.name: 51 · Asesor IA — recomendación o fallback controlado

exec: pm.test('200 con recomendaciones reales, o 503 Problem Details si no hay GROQ_API_KEY', () => { pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.expect(pm.response.json().recommendations).to.be.an('array'); } else { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/problem+json'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/gsk_|Exception|at com\./); } });

pm.test('200 con cotización (real o fallback)', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('fallback'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('soapenv'); });

item.name: 53 · Cotización SOAP con Fault de negocio (negativo)

exec: pm.test('409 Problem Details, sin Fault crudo', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('application/problem+json'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('soapenv'); });
